page.overview:
Who is Ariela's mother?

Ariela's mother was a Human female from Alderaan who was the mother of Ariela. She was present in Eyvind and his daughter's wedding ceremony when young Tusken Raiders killed Eyvind and took Ariela. Later Ariq Joanson saved her.
